A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a new architecture and training method for the joint task of object categorization and 3D object pose estimation, which is a significant step towards the goal of recovering the 3d pose of an object from an image without prior knowledge about the object category.

our architecture is able to achieve the same performance as the state-of-the-art on the 3D object pose estimation with known category task, while at the same time being able to estimate the category of an object in the image.
we are the first to show that the 3D object pose estimation problem can be solved without knowing the object category.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a joint task of object category and 2D pose estimation can be solved with the same accuracy as the simpler 3d pose estimation task.

the problem of joint object categorization and 3D object pose estimation can be solved effectively with a single architecture that can be trained end-to-end, without requiring any additional supervision.
a joint approach to the task of object categorization and 3D object pose estimation is more efficient than the standard approach that solves the two tasks separately.
